profile_text.body:
Serve Robotics Inc. /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Carlos, California, trading under the ticker SERV. Its website presents it as a maker of self-driving delivery robots, framed around the question of why a 2-pound burrito should move in a 2-ton car. The company describes its robots as a low-emissions answer to the last-mile delivery problem and says it is setting a standard for safety on and beyond the sidewalk, protecting customer data, employees, and the public.

The site names one robot, Saymo, and says that when it is not delivering burritos it appears as a sidekick to John Mulaney on the show "Everybody's Live." The company describes itself as a pop culture icon. No AI products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed.

The held facts record legal exposure in California with a count of 270 and list no individual cases. The company profile gives a CIK of 0001832483 and identifies it as a for-profit public company.
